newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan increases gas charges by 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan increases gas charges by 15 pct.

text.p: The Pakistani government on Monday announced a 15 percent increase in natural gas charges from January 1.

Petroleum and Natural Resources Minister Javed Jabbar, quoted by the official APP news agency, told local reporters that caretaker Prime Minister Meraj Khalid's cabinet had decided on the increase to cut the burden of subsidy paid by the government on gas.
He said the government had been giving nearly 50 percent subsidy to domestic consumers and the cabinet approved a 15 percent "in consumer prices for all categories" from January 1.
Jabbar said so far natural gas had not been priced rationally and the government and gas distribution companies had to suffer financial losses in the form of subsidy.
To save the gas companies from huge losses, he said, it was necessary to took immediate steps.
